title: Rumour: Dakota Johnson and Machine Gun Kelly are reported to be dating
summary: People magazine says the pair have been spending more time together. Neither has confirmed it.
body:
This is an unconfirmed report. Actress Dakota Johnson and musician Machine Gun Kelly are dating, according to People magazine, which cited unnamed sources. Neither of them has confirmed a relationship or commented publicly.

People reports that the two have been spending more time together in recent weeks. An earlier report in the magazine, in October, said they were not ready to make anything official.

What has been reported

The pair were photographed leaving a restaurant in Calabasas, California, on 3 November, according to reports citing People.

We will update this story if either of them comments.

Sources: People, as reported by Yahoo Entertainment and the International Business Times.
